hints: Divide isosceles triangle $OBD$ into two congruent right-angled triangles with angle $0.6$ rad.
walkthrough:
Use the right-angled half-triangle formed by dropping a perpendicular from $O$ to the chord $BD$:
$$\text{Half-angle} = \frac{1.2}{2} = 0.6\text{ radians}$$
$$\text{Radius of semicircle } r = 10\sin(0.6)$$

Evaluate $10\sin(0.6)$ in radians to $3$ decimal places:
$$r = 10 \times 0.56464\ldots = 5.646\text{ cm}$$

hints: Find the major sector angle $2\pi - 1.2$ and calculate the major arc length $10(2\pi - 1.2)$.
Calculate the semicircular arc length $\pi r = 5.646\pi$.
Sum the major arc and semicircular arc.
walkthrough:
Calculate the angle and arc length of the major circular sector with radius $10\text{ cm}$:
$$\text{Major angle } \theta = 2\pi - 1.2 \approx 5.0832\text{ radians}$$
$$\text{Major arc length} = 10(2\pi - 1.2) \approx 50.832\text{ cm}$$

Calculate the arc length of the semicircle with radius $r = 5.646\text{ cm}$:
$$\text{Semicircle arc length} = \pi r = \pi(5.646) \approx 17.738\text{ cm}$$

Sum the two boundary arc lengths to find the total perimeter of the metal plate:
$$\text{Perimeter} = 50.832 + 17.738 = 68.57 \approx 68.6\text{ cm}$$

hints: Compute the area of the major sector using $\frac{1}{2}r^2(2\pi - 1.2)$.
Compute the area of $\triangle OBD$ using $\frac{1}{2}(10)(10)\sin(1.2)$.
Compute the area of the semicircle $\frac{1}{2}\pi(5.646)^2$ and add all three areas together.
walkthrough:
Calculate the area of the major circular sector with radius $10\text{ cm}$ and angle $2\pi - 1.2$:
$$\text{Area of major sector} = \frac{1}{2}(10^2)(2\pi - 1.2) = 50(2\pi - 1.2) \approx 254.16\text{ cm}^2$$

Calculate the area of triangle $OBD$ using $\frac{1}{2}ab\sin C$:
$$\text{Area of } \triangle OBD = \frac{1}{2}(10)(10)\sin(1.2) = 50\sin(1.2) \approx 46.60\text{ cm}^2$$

Calculate the area of the semicircle with radius $r = 5.646\text{ cm}$:
$$\text{Area of semicircle} = \frac{1}{2}\pi(5.646)^2 \approx 50.08\text{ cm}^2$$

Sum the three component areas to find the total area of the metal plate:
$$\text{Total Area} = 254.16 + 46.60 + 50.08 = 350.84 \approx 351\text{ cm}^2$$
